route.name: Rotterdam (Coolhaven) - Waterbus - Kinderdijk - Gouda 30 km ENG 2024 (copy)

course_points.n: Start of ride; water on your left
Bear right; continue straight to junction 14
Bear right onto Veerhaven to junction 17
Turn right; directly left to junction 30
Bear right; cross road to junction 02
Turn right onto ferry to junction 61
At roundabout take exit 2 to junction 09
At roundabout take exit 2 to junction 40
Continue straight to mooring; bear right to bike to city center
U - turn to go back to ship
